description: Catalogue-owned integration routes in addition to the options of the client's device inventory (e32/device-inventory.json is kept exactly as the client provided it). A route lets a certified driver serve a model through a vendor system the inventory row names in its connectivity column. The inventory options (and the contract option totals) are unchanged; the wizard and the driver registry accept inventory options plus these routes.

routes.via: GE MUSE v9 / MUSE NX – XML (+ PDF) export folder
routes.reason: The inventory row lists P1 / P4 ('P4 Ethernet/Wi-Fi to MUSE (HL7, XML, DICOM, PDF); P1 serial'): the MAC carts send to the GE MUSE system over P4. The engine reads MUSE's XML export, which from WellnessZ's side is the vendor-software option P2 (driver ecg.ge.muse-xml). The direct P4 route is served by ecg.ge.mac-hl7.
